title: Minuet in G minor (Anna Magdalena Bach Notebook)
video_use_ideas: Minor-key companion to the G major minuet for a wistful aside.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide. Long attributed to J. S. Bach (BWV Anh. numbering) and copied into the 1725 Anna Magdalena Bach Notebook; now credited to Christian Petzold (d.1733). Mutopia piece 76 ('Menuet', for Harpsichord, Piano, Clavichord); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Allen Garvin). Edition source: Bach-Gesellschaft. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
